task_name: C sidebar: geometry store, pinned header with three mode buttons and shortcut, persistence, width plumbing, modal sizing
description: New src/tui/sidebar-geometry.ts (mode store, 34/68-capped-at-half/5 widths, 100-column wide threshold, tui.json persistence, icons, text width). theme.ts gained readTuiConfig/mergeTuiConfig and persistThemeId is now read-merge-write. shell-chrome.ts takes ShellChromeOptions.sidebar: pinned sb-header (sb-title + sb-mode-default|wide|rail buttons), width/padding follow the store, renderer resize feeds geometry.resize, Ctrl+L cycles (gated by overlayActive()), applyTheme recolours the header, rail collapses to a glyph plus the expand button. modal-host.ts sizes against the terminal and mounts its backdrop on the renderer root when a widened sidebar leaves main narrower than 72. tui-shell.ts builds the geometry from the persisted mode, passes it to the chrome with the version, drops the in-scroll title, mounts the legacy sections into one sb-legacy wrapper (hidden in rail), reads the text width at paint time at every mount site and re-fits on geometry change. Fix round: the header shows only TWO buttons (the modes other than the preferred one), each a separate 3-cell renderable with a background, a 1-cell gap between them; rail stacks them under the diamond.
lint_result: pass (npx eslint on sidebar-geometry.ts, shell-chrome.ts, modal-host.ts, theme.ts, tui-shell.ts, sidebar-cards.test.ts)
test_result: sidebar-geometry (21 of 22 pass), modal-host, theme, shell-chrome, tui-shell, capability/tui-layout, capability/no-optional-imports, shell-source-audits, 28 further sidebar/panel/inspector/shell tests and src/lib/config-dir*: all pass. Only failing test: 'flow 468 AC16: at 80x24 in default mode the Session card, the Work card and the toast stay visible' in sidebar-geometry.test.ts (needs ./sidebar-cards, T16). Pty smoke (KERYX_ALLOW_REAL_SUBPROCESS=1): 4 pass, 1 fail, the AC16 80x24 Session/Work card test (T16); the pty frame shows the real header 'keryx v0.3.127 ▢ ▭ ▕'.
acceptance_criteria_met: partial by design: AC13 modal-width part met (modal-host tests green; card part is T16); AC14 met; AC15 met; AC16 geometry/resize part met, the Session/Work card visibility part (sidebar-geometry 80x24 test and the pty smoke test) stays red until T16 delivers the cards.

noticed_not_touched.what: The default width parameters of formatSubagentRow/formatSubagentList, formatJobRow and the options.width ?? fallbacks of the subagent and background-job inspectors still default to the 30-column SIDEBAR_TEXT_WIDTH. The shell now always passes a live width (getter), so the defaults are only hit by callers that pass none; making them follow the geometry would need a process-wide singleton, which would leak between tests.
The boot splash centres itself in terminal width minus the fixed 34-column SIDEBAR_WIDTH; with a persisted wide or rail mode the splash is off-centre until the shell chrome is up.
mountTitlePanel is no longer called by the shell (the chrome header owns sb-title) but stays exported for the flow 266 tests.

assumptions: The active mode button is the PREFERRED mode, so a wide choice on a terminal below 100 columns keeps the wide button lit while default is shown.
Ctrl+L is also inert while the dock, a withOverlay run or any registered overlay source is active; with the / menu open it still cycles.

In rail mode the legacy sections are hidden through one sb-legacy wrapper in tui-shell; the toast and the version-update notice are left in place (they clip in 3 cells) until T16 gives rail its own content.

behavior_changes.description: Header buttons (answered by the operator: «нужно что бы я мог мышкой кликнуть на них и они были раздельные что бы попасть. кстати все 3 показывать не надо, достаточно 2 в которое можно переключить»): two buttons, the modes the sidebar is not set to, each ' <icon> ' (3 cells) on a highlight background with a blank gap cell between; id sb-mode-<target mode>; glyphs ▢ ▭ ▕ with ASCII - = |; rail stacks both under the diamond.
alternatives: a different glyph set (e.g. box-drawing pictograms)
highlight with a background instead of foreground colour

behavior_changes.description: Rail mode after T15: the sidebar is 5 columns with 1 padding cell; the header collapses to a diamond glyph (id sb-title) over a single expand button (sb-mode-default); the existing sections are hidden; the toast and update notice stay but clip. T16 replaces this with one icon and badge per card. (accepted by the operator)
alternatives: keep the legacy sections visible and clipped in rail

behavior_changes.description: With a widened sidebar that leaves main under 72 columns (68 beside 100), the detail modal is sized against the terminal and its backdrop is mounted on the renderer root, so the modal covers the sidebar; with the default sidebar the flow 269 clamp to main is unchanged. (accepted by the operator)
alternatives: shrink the modal below 72 columns inside main
temporarily fall back the sidebar to default while a modal is open

behavior_changes.description: The mode lives under the 'sidebar' key of tui.json and is saved on every button click or Ctrl+L, as the preferred mode; a resize never writes.
